properties.retrospective:
Sprint 4 CLI Integration completed:

What worked:
- Clean integration with existing expression module from Sprints 1-3
- The expression module's public API (parse, execute, validate) worked as designed
- Adding cmd_expr alongside existing cmd_query allows gradual migration
- Integration tests validate all major features

What didn't work initially:
- FunctionSignature.parameters attribute didn't exist (used required_args/optional_args)
- SchemaRegistry.get_schema() was instance method, not class method (used get_registry())
- FieldType.value returned integers, not names (switched to .name)

Key decisions:
- Added 'expr' as new command rather than replacing 'query' for backward compatibility
- Used getattr(manager, '_manager', manager) to support both GoTManager and TransactionalGoTAdapter

Implementation details:
- 343 new lines in cortical/got/cli/query.py
- 234 new lines of integration tests (13 tests, all passing)
- Supports: --type, --format, --count, --list-fields, --list-functions, --explain, --debug

The CLI now bridges the expression DSL (Sprints 1-3) to end users.
